purpose: Verify whether strong public identity markers resolve to independent web sources before counting any source as external entity evidence.
evidence_acceptance_rule: A third-party page must contain a strong identity bridge to this entity, such as the official website, verified telephone, verified official social profile, or another independently verified unique identifier. Name similarity alone is insufficient.
do_not_infer: Do not count generic uses of the phrase Thai-China logistics as this company.
Do not count similarly named logistics businesses without a strong identity bridge.
Do not create or claim reviews, addresses, warehouses, licenses, partnerships or media coverage that have not been verified.
next_actions: Directly audit the official Facebook public fields when accessible.
Align every real external profile to canonical name, website, telephone and service description.
Seek legitimate independent references generated by real business activity rather than mass low-quality directory submissions.
Re-run fixed benchmark queries after external identity signals become publicly discoverable.
